title: Fourth Year Running: MicroHealth Is a Remote Work Top Workplace
summary: MicroHealth earns Remote Work Top Workplace recognition for the fourth year, reflecting its people-first culture and committed success.
body_markdown:
By **Morgan Dingle** | Sep 22, 2026


Vienna, Virginia – MicroHealth LLC, a leading Information Technology company, has once again earned national recognition as a Remote Work Top Workplace. The company ranked 24th in the nation on the 2026 150–499 employee size category list published by[Energage](https://www.energage.com/) . This is MicroHealth’s fourth consecutive year receiving this honor. The award is based on the independent Energage employee engagement survey.


### Four Years Strong: A Culture Built to Last


Winning a Remote Work Top Workplace award once is an achievement. Winning it four years running is a testament. For MicroHealth, this 2026 honor confirms that our[people-first culture](https://www.microhealthllc.com/about-us/) isn’t a moment — it’s a foundation.


“As one of our team members shared, ‘At MicroHealth, I am inspired to be and do my best,’” said Kumud “K” Sharma,[Head of Human Resources.](https://www.microhealthllc.com/about-us/our-team/) “Four years of this recognition tells us our commitment to our people is working — and it’s showing up in the results we deliver for[our clients.](https://www.microhealthllc.com/clients/) ”


### People First, Every Year


Consistency doesn’t happen by accident. MicroHealth’s flexible work model — offering remote, hybrid, and in-office options — allows every team member to build a work rhythm that fits their life, not the other way around.


That commitment is backed by a[comprehensive benefits](https://www.microhealthllc.com/careers/) package available from day one, including:


- 11 paid holidays


- 5–40 hours of paid personal leave


- 10–25 days of paid time off


- Health coverage, tuition reimbursement, and wellness resources


Four consecutive years of recognition reflect four consecutive years of investment — in our people, our culture, and the systems that support them.


### An Honor Earned From the Inside Out


What sets this award apart is its source: MicroHealth employees. Energage’s confidential survey captures genuine engagement and organizational health, offering an unfiltered look at what it’s really like to work here.


This fourth-year milestone reflects an ongoing commitment to remote work excellence, including:


- Smart virtual collaboration tools that keep distributed teams connected and productive


- A people-first culture that holds strong regardless of where employees log in from


- Dedicated resources and support systems that help remote employees thrive, not just survive


### About the Award


Energage is a purpose-driven organization dedicated to helping companies build strong employer brands through its annual Top Workplaces program. Now in its 18th year, the program recognizes top organizations nationally and across more than 60 regional markets.


The Remote Work Top Workplaces award specifically honors organizations that sustain strong, people-first cultures for distributed and remote teams.


“Earning a Top Workplaces award is a badge of honor,” said Eric Rubino, Energage CEO. “It comes authentically from employees. That is something to be proud of. Leaders must ensure employees have a voice and are heard. Top Workplaces do this, and it pays dividends.”


### **Now that we have your attention**


MicroHealth is a service-disabled, Veteran-owned small business making a BIG impact in


[federal IT](https://www.microhealthllc.com/clients/) . From


[agile project management](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/agile-project-management/) and


[advanced cybersecurity](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/devops/) to


[generative AI](https://www.microhealthllc.com/) ,


[data analytics](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/data-analytics/) ,


[software development](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/software-development/) , and more, we deliver secure, innovative solutions for government agencies and the Uniformed Services.


We’re proud to be a five-time Top Workplace USA winner. See more of our awards at


[microhealthllc.com/about-us/awards](https://www.microhealthllc.com/about-us/awards/) .
